title: clutia ovalis
intro: Clutia ovalis, commonly known as the bushy or oval clutia, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Clutia ovalis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
